fourth-lateran-council.description: A painted interior of a stone church or hall, lit by candles. A seated figure in white and gold vestments sits on a raised throne at right, with a bishop's crosier nearby. Rows of mitred bishops sit on wooden benches on both sides, and a robed scribe writes at a lectern in the foreground over an inlaid marble floor. No visible text, frame or graphic content. The era looks medieval or early modern.

celestine-v-resigns.description: An old, bald, white-bearded man in a patched grey-brown hooded robe holds a wooden staff and sets his hands on a silver and gold tiara resting on a rough wooden table. Behind him, several men in red hooded robes and red cloaks stand in a dim stone room with a window at left and a doorway at right. A draped red cloth with gold trim and a white cloth with a black cross lie on the table at lower left. The painting is oil-like, dark and candlelit, and has no visible text or border.

council-constance-ends-schism.description: A painted scene inside a tall Gothic church interior with pointed arches, stained-glass windows and lit candles. A white-robed, gold-vestured man sits enthroned on a red chair at centre, with kneeling red-robed clerics and black-habited monks around him. On the right, a crowned man in ermine-trimmed red robes stands with a raised golden crown-like object, and banners of several nations hang from the pillars. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic.

alexander-vi-elected-pope.description: A heavyset older man with a bald crown sits in an ornate gold-brocade robe with a jeweled brooch, in a dark room lit by two tall candles. A young man in a grey robe kneels at his feet, and a few men in red cardinal robes stand or sit behind them. A chest of gold coins sits to the right beside a young attendant in red who holds the gold train. The setting is a dark palace interior with heavy drapes and a stone arch. I see no visible text, no frame, and no blood or nudity.

clement-xiv-suppresses-jesuits.description: An elderly man in a red velvet cape with white fur trim and a red skullcap sits at a dark wooden desk writing with a quill on a long scroll with a red wax seal. A black-robed man stands at his shoulder reading a sheet of paper. Two clergy in black cassocks stand with bowed heads near the right wall. The room is ornate, with gilt picture frames, a crucifix on the wall, a tall window with drapes, and a stack of papers on the desk.

pius-ix-elected-pope.description: A pope in a white cassock with a red and gold mantle stands on a stone balcony, right hand raised in blessing. A cardinal in red stands to the left holding a crucifix-topped staff. Below, a dense crowd of men in top hats and women in bonnets and shawls waves white handkerchiefs in a sunlit square. Behind them are classical buildings, a tall obelisk and statues. No visible text, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge.

papal-infallibility-declared.description: Interior of a large basilica-like hall with a barrel-vaulted, coffered ceiling and gilded details. Rows of bishops in white mitres and white-and-red vestments fill the foreground and sides, many with raised hands. At the far end, a figure in white sits on a throne on a raised dais with a red carpet, flanked by candles and a canopy. Lightning flashes through tall arched windows on the right under a dark storm sky. The image fills the frame edge to edge with no border.

benedict-xvi-elected-pope.description: A painted rooftop with a chimney releasing a thick white plume into a dark, stormy dusk sky. Beyond the roofline a large domed basilica stands over a dense crowd of people holding umbrellas and flags in a square, with a tall obelisk in the middle of the square. There is no visible text, no frame, and no people in close view.

francis-elected-first-latin-american-pop.description: A painted nighttime scene in heavy rain. In the centre, a stone palace facade with an arched balcony framed by red velvet drapes, a warm lit interior behind, and a lectern with microphones on the balcony. A red velvet banner hangs over the balcony rail. Below, a dense crowd holds dark umbrellas and flags, including light-blue-and-white striped Argentine flags and several other flags. Statues stand on the side rooftops, and lamp posts light the square. No visible text.

leo-xiv-elected-first-american-pope.description: A painting at dusk: a thick white smoke plume rises from a small chimney on a low classical building at left. A large domed basilica with a lit facade and statues fills the right side. In the foreground a dense crowd of silhouetted people raises arms and waves flags, mostly American stars-and-stripes, plus yellow-and-white and other flags. Warm orange sky, dark clouds, painterly brushwork, edge to edge with no frame.
